difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that a syntomic morphism is Gorenstein, equivalently that a flat local complete intersection morphism is Gorenstein (statement lines 6558-6562). The proof recalls that a syntomic morphism is flat with local complete intersection fibres over fields by Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-syntomic-flat-fibres, observes that a local complete intersection over a field is a Gorenstein scheme by Lemma labelled lemma-gorenstein-lci, and concludes, the equivalence of the two notions being More on Morphisms, Lemma labelled more-morphisms-lemma-flat-lci (proof lines 6564-6573). Assembling flatness, the fibre-wise criterion and the field case into the claimed implication, and matching the two equivalent definitions of the notion, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
